title: Workspace state file
description: Persisted project-workspace state, ~/.local/state/punar/workspaces.json (spec sections 13.5, 14.1, 14.3; exact shape decided in docs/development/milestone-2.md section 6). Machine-emitted JSON runtime record. Writer in Milestone 2 is punar-shell (QML FileView, atomic tmp+rename), debounced on renameworkspace events and layout-preset changes; the punar-workspace daemon (spec section 11.5) takes over as writer in Milestone 3+. The typed Rust twin is crates/punar-workspace (WorkspacesFile / WorkspaceState). One deliberate camelCase exception: the top-level key is 'layoutPreset', fixed verbatim by the milestone-2 decision record and asserted by the M2 CI exercise; all other keys are snake_case per the runtime-record convention. Two ordering rules are enforced by the writer, not expressible here: 'workspaces' is sorted by strictly ascending 'id' (which also forbids duplicate ids).

version.title: State schema version
version.description: Version of this file's shape. Const 1 for this schema; readers reject files declaring a newer version and a breaking change bumps the version.

updated.title: Last write time
updated.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last write, e.g. 2026-08-25T09:30:00Z (milestone-2 section 6: UTC ISO-8601).

layoutPreset.title: Global active layout preset
layoutPreset.description: The active layout preset (spec section 13.5); presets are global in Milestone 2. The M2 writer emits only 'balanced', 'columns', 'rows', 'focus', or 'stack': 'grid' is a spec 13.5 name with no shipped mapping in M2 (Hyprland 0.56.2 has no native grid algorithm) and 'custom' is reserved for a layout diverged from any preset — both are admitted for forward compatibility with the Milestone 3+ daemon.

workspaces.title: Named workspaces
workspaces.description: Entries only for workspaces with non-empty names, sorted by strictly ascending id (writer-enforced ordering).

layout_preset.title: Layout preset name
layout_preset.description: The six spec section 13.5 preset names plus 'custom'. Lowercase snake_case values per the enum convention.

workspace_state.title: Workspace entry
workspace_state.description: One named project workspace (spec section 14). Milestone 2 writes only 'id' and 'name'; 'layout_preset' and 'monitor' are optional fields reserved for the Milestone 3+ daemon and never emitted by the M2 shell.

id.title: Workspace number
id.description: Hyprland workspace id, >= 1. Special workspaces (negative ids, special: names) are never persisted.

name.title: Project workspace name
name.description: Milestone-2 section 6 name rule: 1-32 characters, ASCII alphanumeric first character, then ASCII alphanumerics, spaces, underscores, or hyphens. No commas (Hyprland's socket2 renameworkspace event frames as ID,NAME) and no leading 'special' (Hyprland's reserved special-workspace prefix, excluded via the 'not' subschema).

layout_preset.title: Per-workspace preset override (reserved)
layout_preset.description: Reserved for Milestone 3+: layout presets are global in Milestone 2 (milestone-2 section 2), so the M2 writer never emits this field.

monitor.title: Last monitor (reserved)
monitor.description: Reserved for Milestone 3+: monitor memory (spec section 15) is out of Milestone 2 scope, so the M2 writer never emits this field.
